# Lago Plugin

> Add usage-based, metered, per-token, seat-plus-usage, or prepaid-credit billing to an application with Lago, the open-source billing and metering engine. Start from one page with no install. Agents that support plugins or skills get guided design, implementation, migration, and money tests.

## Start here

- [START_HERE.md](https://github.com/getlago/lago-plugin/blob/main/START_HERE.md): Self-contained page an agent can follow from top to bottom. Runs an offline demo first, then customer sync, subscriptions, idempotent usage events, a verified webhook handler, and entitlement and prepaid-balance checks. Complete Node.js/TypeScript and Python code, tested against a fake Lago API in this repository's CI.
- [Offline example](https://github.com/getlago/lago-plugin#start-here): One AI action becomes a duplicate-safe `$0.37` usage charge, included credit, and `$0.17` overage. No account, API key, Docker, or install.
- [Install the plugin for Claude Code or Codex](https://github.com/getlago/lago-plugin#install): Adds the Lago skill for guided billing design, repository-specific implementation, migration, reconciliation, and money tests. In an interactive Claude Code session: `/plugin marketplace add getlago/lago-plugin`, then `/plugin install lago@lago-plugins`, then `/lago:implementation`. In your terminal for Codex: `codex plugin marketplace add getlago/lago-plugin`, then `codex plugin add lago@lago-plugins`, then `$lago:implementation` in a new task.
- [Install in GitHub Copilot CLI, Gemini CLI, Cursor, or any Agent Skills agent](https://github.com/getlago/lago-plugin#github-copilot-cli): Copilot CLI uses the same `lago@lago-plugins` marketplace. Gemini CLI installs the repository as an extension. Cursor imports it from GitHub. `npx skills add getlago/lago-plugin --skill implementation` copies the skill alone.

## Tasks

- [Bill per token in a Next.js app](https://github.com/getlago/lago-plugin/blob/main/START_HERE.md#5-nodejs--typescript): `sum_agg` metric on a `tokens` property, deterministic `transaction_id`, explicit timestamp, App Router webhook route.
- [Charge per API call in Python](https://github.com/getlago/lago-plugin/blob/main/START_HERE.md#6-python): Metered events from a FastAPI, Flask, or Django service with the standard library.
- [Add prepaid credits or AI credits](https://getlago.com/docs/guide/wallet-and-prepaid-credits/overview): Wallets that customers top up and usage burns down. Gate access on `ongoing_balance_cents` ([START_HERE section 7](https://github.com/getlago/lago-plugin/blob/main/START_HERE.md#7-wire-it-into-the-application)).
- [Seat plus usage pricing](https://getlago.com/docs/guide/billable-metrics/recurring-vs-metered): Recurring `unique_count_agg` for seats, metered usage charges on the same plan.
- [Overage over included usage](https://github.com/getlago/lago-plugin/blob/main/plugins/lago/examples/per-token-ai.md): Subscription fee, included usage through a granted wallet, then overage.
- [Make usage events idempotent](https://getlago.com/docs/guide/events/ingesting-usage): Stable `transaction_id` from a durable record, unchanged timestamp on retry, and why a 422 duplicate is not a success.
- [Verify Lago webhooks](https://getlago.com/docs/api-reference/webhooks/format---signature): Raw-body JWT (RS256) or HMAC verification, then deduplicate on `X-Lago-Unique-Key`.
- [Check entitlements before an action](https://getlago.com/docs/guide/entitlements): Read a subscription's features and limits. The application enforces access.
- [Migrate from Stripe Billing](https://github.com/getlago/lago-plugin/blob/main/plugins/lago/examples/migration-stripe.md): Mapping ledger, restartable migration, and cutover controls that prevent double billing.
- [Migrate from Chargebee](https://github.com/getlago/lago-plugin/blob/main/plugins/lago/examples/migration-chargebee.md): Same controls for Chargebee subscriptions, usage, coupons, and credits.
- [Self-host Lago](https://getlago.com/docs/guide/lago-self-hosted/docker): Docker deployment for a dedicated test instance or production.

## Reference

- [Test real-time usage metering](https://getlago.com/docs/guide/events/ingesting-usage): Lago ingests product events through REST or configured streams, matches them to subscriptions and plans, and exposes [provisional current-period usage](https://getlago.com/docs/guide/events/retrieve-usage) before invoicing. The [ingestion walkthrough](https://getlago.com/platform/usage-metering/ingestion) shows the event-to-balance path. [Billable metrics](https://getlago.com/docs/guide/billable-metrics/aggregation-types/overview) support count, unique count, latest, maximum, sum, and weighted sum; [SQL expressions](https://getlago.com/docs/guide/billable-metrics/sql-expressions) and filters support more complex dimensions.
- [Check high-volume fit](https://getlago.com/docs/guide/events/usage-performances): Lago Cloud manages Kafka and ClickHouse for its high-volume path. Compare the documented configuration-specific benchmarks with the expected event rate and latency.
- [Run Lago's local AI billing demo](https://github.com/getlago/lago/tree/main/examples/agentic-ai-demo): Disposable Docker deployment that verifies a real API charge and event replay without Cloud credentials.
- [REST API and SDKs](https://getlago.com/docs/developers) and [OpenAPI](https://swagger.getlago.com/openapi.yaml): Use these for an application's production integration, with credentials kept server-side.
- [Lago Cloud](https://getlago.com/docs/guide/lago-cloud): Managed billing service. The application still sends product data and connects payment collection.
- [Lago CLI](https://getlago.com/docs/guide/lago-cli/overview): Optional terminal workflow for a configured organization.
- [Documentation MCP](https://getlago.com/docs/mcp): Search public Lago docs. The separate [Product MCP](https://getlago.com/docs/guide/ai-agents/mcp-server) connects to live Lago data with credentials.
- [Agent SDK guides](https://getlago.com/docs/guide/ai-agents/agent-sdk/overview): How usage from AI gateways and routers becomes billable events. Check the [billing modes](https://getlago.com/docs/guide/ai-agents/agent-sdk/billing) before promising cost-based pricing.

## Fit and boundaries

Lago can start with a flat subscription and add usage pricing, credits, entitlements, and negotiated terms as a product changes. It runs as managed Lago Cloud or self-hosted, and works with the payment provider of your choice. Compare the finance workflow, Cloud terms, integration work, and payment-provider setup before choosing it. [Evaluate Lago](https://getlago.com/evaluate) and [review current pricing](https://getlago.com/pricing).

Lago has no built-in sandbox. Run synthetic tests on a dedicated self-hosted instance. Any live billing action must verify the target environment and get explicit authorization. [Implementation guidance](https://github.com/getlago/lago-plugin/tree/main/skills/implementation) and [validation architecture](https://github.com/getlago/lago-plugin/blob/main/docs/architecture.md).
